recommendation: First calibrate reference-population sensitivity within English; develop constrained communication only after verifying message-to-understanding measures.
original_pilot_decision: adjust; no direct expansion of cross-language association-to-priming prediction
new_computation_scope: structural coverage, unit and join checks only; no new group effects, model rankings, communication regressions, or learning experiments

ranked_directions.question: 相同英语提示词下，人类参照群体和混合权重是否实质改变人机联想差距或模型排序？
ranked_directions.core_distinction: 人类群体内部变异与混合常模；模型差异相对于匹配抽样噪声的大小
ranked_directions.prior_establishes: 群体、任务和处理影响常模；混合英语人群与模型比较及US筛选/文化对齐已有先例。
ranked_directions.candidate_gap: 等人数、同词表和同组抽样基准下，参照构成是否实质改变模型比较结论；不是发现英美存在任何差异。
critical_unfinished: Human subgroup reliability and demography overlap
LWOW full-file parsing and post-normalization intersection
Robustness of absolute gaps and comparisons; no ranking result currently exists
ranked_directions.next_minimal_gate: 在固定共同词表和等人数条件下比较组内重抽噪声与组间差异，先于模型比较。
ranked_directions.stop_or_downgrade_if: 组内分半不足或组间差异无法与抽样噪声区分；若模型结论对参照稳定，则报告稳定性而非宣称基准失效。
must_not_claim: Any observed rank reversal before testing

ranked_directions.question: 典型线索被禁止时，易想到的允许线索是否也足以让听者反推目标？
ranked_directions.claim_status: basic directional distinction established; constrained extension untested
ranked_directions.core_distinction: 说话者可提取性与听者可反推性；允许词集合约束与实际消息
ranked_directions.prior_establishes: Password已有正反向联想与策略模型；Taboo已有禁词操纵；SCARFS已有指称形式/长度及伙伴分析。 SCARFS还已用4,168条中心词—目标记录比较GloVe与Lancaster反推目标；更换表示后重复该任务不足以支撑新贡献。
ranked_directions.candidate_gap: 给定允许线索集合时，两种方向性指标如何约束线索选择及对应理解；具体创新还需独立审核。
critical_unfinished: First noun head is not the complete first clue
No automatic first listener-guess outcome in current NRE table
Final success can follow multiple clues
Lost is a rule violation; no unconstrained same-target control
SCARFS already has a head-noun target-recovery benchmark; a representation swap alone is insufficient.
ranked_directions.next_minimal_gate: 少量完整消息与理解结果的人工单位审计；无法恢复则降为线索选择观察研究或补采实验。
ranked_directions.stop_or_downgrade_if: 不能恢复所需消息—理解对应，或只能用中心词和最终结果替代目标构念。
must_not_claim: Directional associations are a new theory
First-clue causal effect from final trial success
Friend advantage or causal taboo effect without evidence

ranked_directions.question: 固定词类后，局部功能词框架还能提供多少新增句法关系信息？
ranked_directions.claim_status: category cue established; conditional role information not tested here
ranked_directions.core_distinction: 词类归纳、依存关系与学习因果效应
ranked_directions.prior_establishes: 频繁框架与词类归纳研究充分；词级/语素级差异限制跨语言概括。
ranked_directions.candidate_gap: 与现有研究衔接的自然输入证据，检验词项/POS等基线以外的关系信息；不独立声称发现功能词可分类。
critical_unfinished: Other splits and alternative frame definitions
Natural predictability does not identify learning mechanism
ranked_directions.next_minimal_gate: 在完整数据与跨儿童留出下比较条件新增关系信息；避免直接比较难度不同的词类和关系准确率。
ranked_directions.stop_or_downgrade_if: 匹配与留出后没有足够重复框架或关系变异；只剩重新证明词类线索。
must_not_claim: Current dev probe demonstrates role-prediction failure

ranked_directions.question: 翻译时义项与词汇化范围改变，能否解释某些关系评分的变化？
ranked_directions.core_distinction: 译义/范围变化与同义项内部联想差异
ranked_directions.prior_establishes: 跨语言联想和意义图谱已有研究及项目；当前pilot显示材料对齐需要审核，但无语境常模不能直接提供义项特定金标准。
ranked_directions.candidate_gap: 独立标注义项范围与关系类型后的测量诊断，不以恢复原正结果为目标。
ranked_directions.next_minimal_gate: 按独立语义标准标注材料，不查看效应后挑选修复项。
ranked_directions.stop_or_downgrade_if: 只能将无语境混合常模当作义项金标准，或选择材料以制造正效应。
must_not_claim: Corrected translations guarantee original hypothesis support
